_doc: Battle Arena corridor (Emerald 18x14): a walkway round the battle hall. The attendant walks the player from the arrival (9,13) left along rows 12-13, up the left side (x 0-2) and along row 4 to the hall's door (5,3..4) (scripted, no warps); Emerald's mirror door (12,3..4) on the right. The hall (Emerald x 6-11 rows 0-4, x 3-14 rows 5-11) is left out of the floor: its walls stand round it, its inside is the dark; the doors are openings in its side walls ("open" (6,3..4), (11,3..4)). Pots in the four corners (blocked), a green mat at the arrival.
